player_prompt.intro:
Yin e raan {player_id} ee Quantum Tic Tac Toe.
Raan ee '{symbol}', ku akɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈ɔ̈n ee {parity} (tɛ̈ɛ̈n, X1, X3 ku O2, O4).

Kɔc: Yɛ̈n wɛ̈ɛ̈n kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k cɔ̈ɔ̈k ee tɛ̈ɛ̈n kɔ̈k kɔ̈k.

Kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈ɔ̈n:
- Ɛ̈ɛ̈n kɔ̈ɔ̈n, tɛ̈ɛ̈n raan ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k kɔ̈k ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n '[a,b]'.
- Kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k ee kuɛ̈ɛ̈n, ku cɔ̈ɔ̈k ee 'X1 / X1' ku 'O4 / O4'.
- Yɛ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n raan ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n.

Kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈ɔ̈n ee kuɛ̈ɛ̈n:
- Na kɔ̈ɔ̈n yɛ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n kɔ̈k ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n, ee kuɛ̈ɛ̈n tɛ̈ɛ̈n.
- Kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k ee kuɛ̈ɛ̈n ee tɛ̈ɛ̈n kɔ̈k ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n.
- Kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k ee kuɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k.

Wɛ̈ɛ̈n:
- Kɔ̈ɔ̈n ee kɔ̈k wɛ̈ɛ̈n kɔ̈k ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k.
- Na kɔ̈ɔ̈n ee kɔ̈k wɛ̈ɛ̈n kɔ̈k, ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k wɛ̈ɛ̈n.

Kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k ee '[0,4]' tɛ̈ɛ̈n raan ee kɔ̈ɔ̈n 0 ku 4.

invalid_move.invalid_cells: Kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k ee tɛ̈ɛ̈n ku kɔ̈ɔ̈n kɔ̈k.
invalid_move.already_solidified: Kɛl kä thëlli̱ ɛ mi̱ ci̱ rɔ riɛ̈p.

game_action.placed: Player {player_id} wɛt ee rɔt kuɔɔp thok ke ye symbol ee rɔt kuɔɔp thok ke ye superposition giɛɛ thok ke ye cells {pos_a} na {pos_b}.

game_message.dependent_resolved: Dependent superposition cɛŋ. Cell ({r}, {c}) ee rɔt kuɔɔp thok ke ye {symbol}.
game_message.last_cell_resolved: Superposition kuɔɔp thok ke ye last cell cɛŋ. Cell ({r}, {c}) ee rɔt kuɔɔp thok ke ye {symbol}.
game_message.superposition_resolved: Superposition cɛŋ. Cell ({r}, {c}) ee rɔt kuɔɔp thok ke ye {symbol}.

outcome.win: Ji̱ ŋarä {player_id} ci̱kɛ wɔ̱ kɛ ɣöö bi̱ kɛn tin ca gɔ̱a̱r käp ɛ bum!
outcome.draw: Ɛn duel ɛ mi̱ caa kuɛn!
